title: Meno pack attribution log (CONTRIBUTORS.yml)
description: Who made what inside one pack, at the smallest unit a pull request actually touches. Canonical prose definition: content/community/README.md. Records are append-only and oldest-first; attribution resolves by nearest ancestor, so a pack written by one person needs exactly one record and finer records exist only where authorship differs. PACK.md's amendment log owns the narrative why; this file owns who, what, and when.

unit.description: pack | objectives/<course-objective-id> | modules/<slug> | modules/<slug>/lessons/<file.md> (resolves against that module.yml's lessons[].file, since packs ship no lesson bodies) | modules/<slug>/sources/<url> (keyed on the source url, which survives re-archiving and reordering) | notes/<file.md>

by.description: the contributor's GitHub handle, @-prefixed, or the literal anonymous - packs land only through pull requests, so a handle always exists. Never an email, a real name, a tenant id, or anything read off the publisher's machine.

action.description: removed records are exempt from unit resolution - they record that a unit once existed, not that it still does

note.description: optional one line of context, sanitized like any other published prose
